400851601.text: #Ladies and gentlemen, after some fierce competition in the rounds so far, we arrive, at long last, at the final of the Nilotpala Cup! It's time to find out who is the very best beast-tamer of all: Haniyyah or the Traveler, {NICKNAME}!

400851602.text: If the winner of the final round makes it through the Ultimate Trial, they will acquire my entire fortune. It will then be their responsibility to continue hosting this tournament into the future and to promote the philosophy of peaceful coexistence throughout all of Teyvat...

400851603.text: Kautilya isn't here today... This is our chance! After the final match and the Ultimate Trial, we'll go tip off Elchingen, and confront Kautilya head on!

400851605.text: You bring Miko and Layla up to speed on your conversation with Haniyyah and your plan for today.

400851606.text: Much as I expected. The insufferable research maniac has exposed his true colors to our two protagonists... You seem to be edging ever closer to the truth.

400851607.text: Holding off on reporting Kautilya to the Akademiya seems like a sensibly cautious decision at this stage. Who's to say if Kautilya — or indeed, anyone else for that matter — is really who they appear to be?

400851608.text: Yeah, we can't afford to let our guards down now. We gotta fight Haniyyah first, the strongest beast-tamer out there. And we still have no idea what we're in for with Elchingen's Ultimate Trial.

400851609.text: How are we gonna get through to Haniyyah, though...

400851610.text: The answer should be quite obvious by now, surely?

400851611.text: Take all of our Fungi and defeat her fair and square. Force her to let go of her stubborn attitude and listen to the truth.

400851612.text: I believe in you guys... I know you'll be able to get her to come around!

400851614.text: Aw, yeah! Bongo-Head, Twirly-Whirly, and Blitzara, the tightest power-trio in all of shroomdom!

400851615.text: With your powers combined, winning this final will be easier than taking a radish from a hilichurl!

400851501.text: #The day has finally arrived, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

400851502.text: I warned you not to get emotionally attached to the Fungi. You have to treat them as your pawns...

400851503.text: But it seems like you haven't changed one bit. In which case, this match will be a short one.

400851506.text: Yeah! When we send Bongo-Head and buddies into action, it's like clockwork! And we ain't about to stop tickin'!

400851507.text: *sigh* ...Time to show you how a real beast-tamer fights. Your feeble strategy will be your undoing! Go, Pyro-1!

400850401.text: How in the... Pyro-1, why did you hold back?

400850404.text: Don't blame Pyro-1, Haniyyah. And don't force yourself to do something you don't want to. You started having second thoughts when Pyro-1 got injured during the semifinals, didn't you?

400850405.text: You'd never met a well-matched opponent until you fought Miko and now us, had you? So you've never had to put Pyro-1 or any of your other Fungi in danger before.

400850406.text: When you saw one of your Fungi get injured for the first time, you realized you felt compassion for it.

400850407.text: "Compassion"? You really think I feel anything for these Fungi?

400850501.text: I've failed... Just before the most important step of all, I've failed...

400850502.text: You two... you were the only ones who could stop me. But how, when your mindset is so childish?

400850505.text: Haniyyah, as we agreed, you have to hear us out now that we've won.

400850506.text: But let's put that aside for now. Can we bring Pyro-1 along for the Ultimate Trial?

400850507.text: Pyro-1? You want to take it with you?

400850508.text: Yep! We wanna pass the Ultimate Trial with everyone's Fungi side-by-side: Bongo-Head, Twirly-Whirly, Blitzara, and Pyro-1.

400850801.text: What's going on here... Why are there Fatui everywhere?

400850802.text: Elchingen, the arena's been taken over by bad guys! We'll deal with them — get yourself to safety!

400850803.text: Wait a second... Where is the exit?

400850806.text: The Traveler is correct. Nothing gets past you, does it? In which case, I presume you planned for this eventuality... no?

400850807.text: Wait, this is all wrong... Isn't this the Ultimate Trial? Kautilya's supposed to be the villain! He was just using this tournament for his own agenda, and he tricked you into sponsoring him...

400850808.text: Hmm, not far off. You're right about Kautilya's motivations — this started when he discovered a promising use for a forgotten technology.

400850809.text: So I bought his loyalty and organized this tournament to expand the reach of his technology. Though I must say, I never expected a prize catch like yourself to take the bait so eagerly.

subQuests.subQuestName: Hold your ground against your opponent's attacks
Hold your ground against your opponent's attacks

400850902.text: There are too many of them...

400850903.text: This isn't right... I've activated the backdoor command three times now on the Floating Hydro Fungus, why is it still obeying the Traveler?

400850905.text: Oh dear, the poor thing still hasn't realized.

400850906.text: The technology in the Wisdom Orb does make Fungi more obedient to their beast-tamers, but all it does to achieve this is suppress some of their basic instincts, allowing them to communicate with their owner as effectively as any other animal.

400850907.text: The trust that these four Fungi place in their beast-tamers, and the bond they now share, have grown stronger than the Wisdom Orb.

400850908.text: Yae Miko... Y—You broke the domain-sealing spell?

400850909.text: Please! You thought your crude replicas could keep me out? You appear to have woefully underestimated who you're dealing with...

400850910.text: Not to mention that shoddily designed backdoor command... Did you honestly believe that no one would notice the litany of vulnerabilities in your grand plan?

400850913.text: Elchingen... So this was all YOUR doing!?

400850914.text: Whatever threat the Fungi might pose, your nefarious ambitions are the true menace here...

400850915.text: C'mon, Miss Yae... Let's go help them!

400850916.text: Easy now, Layla. All that's left for us to do now is to watch and wait. The bond of companionship is not something so easily severed by the designs or devices of humans.

400850917.text: Blitzara, you haven't completed your mission yet. You're not thinking of giving up now, are you?

400850918.text: Huh? Look, Blitzara's back to normal!

400850919.text: Is this the moment Miss Yae said we were waiting for...?

400850920.text: Twirly-Whirly, I believe in you! Take this crook down... *coughing*

400850921.text: The backdoor command is wearing off... They're all returning to normal!

400850922.text: Still doubting what your heart tells you, Haniyyah?

400850923.text: You're afraid... afraid to accept that the Fungus you treated as a pawn now trusts you completely. Because then you'll be forced to face your true feelings, which you have been trying so desperately to escape from.

400850924.text: But don't keep your Fungus waiting much longer... Look, now that it's no longer under the Wisdom Orb's control, it's waiting for your orders.

400850925.text: Pyro-1... Are you really waiting for me?

400850926.text: I'm sorry, I... I've been so harsh on you, but you still trust me...

400850927.text: Go, do what you have to do.

400850928.text: ...Well, one way or another, it looks like all the Fungi have returned to their senses! Great!

400850929.text: Shame on you, Elchingen! You're about to pay for what you've done!

400850930.text: Hold the line, and keep your heads. They're just a handful of Fungi. We still have the upper hand.

subQuests.subQuestName: Catch up with and defeat Elchingen

400851001.text: Beaten by a few measly Fungi... This is absurd!

400851002.text: Where do you think you're going?

400851003.text: Miko! Why didn't you stop him!?

400851004.text: Hmm? Oh, I'm just a tourist. As far as I'm aware, I don't have the authority to detain anybody within Sumeru's borders... Is that not the case for you, too?

400851005.text: Still, you needn't worry. He won't escape. You'll see once you get back to the tournament arena.

400851006.text: Huh, cryptic... Well, no time to figure that one out — on with the chase!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Corps of Thirty mercenary

400851201.text: You're from... the Corps of Thirty?

400851203.text: By order of the General Mahamatra, we're here to arrest Elchingen for grave crimes, and Kautilya for academic misconduct.

400851204.text: The General Mahamatra has been watching Kautilya closely for some time. He's busy dealing with other affairs today, so he couldn't find the time to apprehend the offenders himself. Thankfully, with all the evidence you gathered, we were able to swiftly bring this case to a conclusion.

400851205.text: The General Mahamatra wrote a letter for the two of you. Please take a look.

400851206.text: So Cyno's been keeping an eye on this competition, too. He and his people must have been secretly investigating at the same time as we were! Lucky we had some backup!

400851209.text: Alright, we'll take the suspects away now. The arena will be unattended while we're gone, but with you here, I can put my mind at ease.

400851210.text: You might think this is over, but mark my words...

400851211.text: You haven't seen the last of me... or of Master Dottore.

400851212.text: Oh, quit while you're behind, loser! Have fun in prison, you Fatui low-life!

400851213.text: Wait, Cyno mentioned that he used our evidence. So... is that where Miko was going after the Last 16? To hand it in and make a report?

400851214.text: Oh please, spare me that look. I didn't sign up for any of this. I'm supposed to be having a nice vacation, but all sorts of vexing issues keep managing to find their way to me...

400851215.text: After the round of 16, I simply took a walk around Sumeru City with my editors. I did have a very brief conversation with the General Mahamatra, but only because he happened to be passing by at the time. The evidence you gathered was the key to solving this case.

400851216.text: Uhh... The more you try playing it down, the more confusing it all sounds...

400851217.text: Um, anyway, now that the organizer and the sponsor have both been arrested, what should we do about the Fungi and this tournament?

400851218.text: The rules still stand. These little ones won the tournament and passed the Ultimate Trial, which means they'll be taking Elchingen and Kautilya's place.

400851219.text: From now on, everything about this tournament will be up to these two to decide. And after all the experience they've gained, I'm sure they are more than up to the task.
